svg.title: Ila says the town will judge the trial through lived public services.
svg.desc: Ila takes the same public position as Vale but holds her red ledger and speaks with compact, quiet authority. Behind her, Babul's van and working traffic keep the launch tied to daily life.
svg.text: Page 26, panel 4 · Matched medium shot of Ila taking the same speaking position

text.tspan: Ila tells the square that the town will judge the
trial by lived service, not the ceremony.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
